mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_notification_delivery (event_id, event_type, channel, recipient_key, recipient_id, recipient_address, template_code, title, content, params_json, status, attempts, max_attempts, next_retry_time, last_error, message_id, sent_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{channel}, #{recipientKey}, #{recipientId}, #{recipientAddress}, #{templateCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{paramsJson}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastError}, #{messageId}, #{sentTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

where.if: AND (recipient_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{recipient}, '%') OR recipient_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{recipient}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_notification_delivery WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_retry_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM sys_notification_delivery WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notification_delivery SET status = #{status}, attempts = #{attempts}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, message_id = #{messageId}, sent_time = #{sentTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_notification_delivery SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = '发送超时，等待重试', next_retry_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'SENDING' AND update_time < #{threshold}
UPDATE sys_notification_delivery SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, next_retry_time = #{now}, last_error = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD')
